mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_committee_vote (id, process_instance_id, task_id, sub_task_id, committee_name, committee_member_id, vote, comment, voted_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{processInstanceId}, #{taskId}, #{subTaskId}, #{committeeName}, #{committeeMemberId}, #{vote}, #{comment}, #{votedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_committee_vote SET vote = #{vote}, comment = #{comment}, voted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{voteId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wf_committee_vote WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY voted_at
SELECT * FROM wf_committee_vote WHERE process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId} ORDER BY voted_at
